mapper.select: SELECT ms.*, m.material_name, m.material_code, m.specification, m.unit, m.moisture_proof FROM material_stock ms LEFT JOIN material m ON ms.material_id = m.id WHERE ms.material_id = #{materialId} AND ms.deleted = 0 AND ms.quantity > 0 ORDER BY ms.inbound_date ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM material_stock WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND deleted = 0 AND stock_status != 3
mapper.update: UPDATE material_stock SET quantity = quantity + #{changeQuantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{stockId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.material_name, m.material_code, m.material_type, m.unit, m.warning_stock, COALESCE(SUM(ms.quantity), 0) AS total_stock, SUM(CASE WHEN ms.stock_status = 1 THEN ms.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS normal_stock, SUM(CASE WHEN ms.stock_status = 2 THEN ms.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS warning_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN ms.stock_status = 3 THEN ms.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS expired_stock, COUNT(DISTINCT ms.id) AS batch_count FROM material m LEFT JOIN material_stock ms ON m.id = ms.material_id AND ms.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.material_name, m.material_code, m.material_type, m.unit, m.warning_stock ORDER BY total_stock DESC
